lessons.titleZh: 暫不作定案，保留選項

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: They want to keep their options open.

brief.meaningEn: Avoid making a commitment that closes off alternatives before one is ready to decide.
brief.meaningZh: 未準備好決定前，避免作出會封閉其他可能的承諾。
brief.grammar: keep your options open / kept her options open; options are alternatives still genuinely available, not choices guaranteed to remain forever.
brief.boundaryZh: 保留選項不等於已同時承諾所有邀請，也不保證可無限期拖延；需留意期限並清楚告知對方尚未定案。
brief.misconceptionZh: 保留選項不等於已同時承諾所有邀請，也不保證可無限期拖延；需留意期限並清楚告知對方尚未定案。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「暫不作定案，保留選項」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: I asked when the application decision was needed because I wanted to keep my options open until I had seen the other course timetable; I had not accepted either place yet.
listening.zh: 我問申請需要何時決定，因為想等看過另一課程時間表前保留選項；我尚未接受任何一個課程名額。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 說話者尚未接受，想了解期限後再比較課程安排。
說話者已向兩個課程承諾一定出席。
兩個課程已保證永久為說話者保留位置。
說話者已放棄其中一個課程，現在只查詢教材。

listening.explanationZh: had not accepted 與decision needed 表明未定案但有期限，不是已答應兩邊或永久保留。

reply.promptEn: Why did you ask about the decision deadline?
reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼詢問決定期限？

options.en: I wanted to keep my options open until I could compare the course timetables.
options.zh: 我想先保留選項，直到能比較課程時間表。

options.en: I needed to know how long I could consider both courses without misleading either organiser.
options.zh: 我需要知道可考慮兩個課程多久，而不誤導任何一方主辦者。

options.en: The other timetable might affect my choice, so I was not ready to accept a place.
options.zh: 另一時間表可能影響選擇，所以我未準備好接受課程名額。

options.en: I wanted a clear date for deciding rather than leave my answer indefinitely uncertain.
options.zh: 我想有清楚的決定日期，不把答覆無限期擱着。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 人物想比較兩個邀請，卻已對兩邊都說「我一定參加」，而時間相撞。她稱這只是保留選項。哪句最準確？

options.en: Keeping her options open would require being clear that she has not committed; promising both has already created conflicting expectations.
options.zh: 保留選項需要說清未承諾；答應兩邊，已造成相互衝突的期待。

options.en: Promising both is the same as telling both organisers that no decision has been made.
options.zh: 答應兩邊，跟告訴兩邊主辦者尚未決定是一樣的。

options.en: A timetable clash shows that neither invitation was ever a genuine opportunity.
options.zh: 時間相撞顯示兩個邀請從來都不是真正機會。

scene.explanationZh: 保留與接受不同；可有兩個真實機會但無法同時履行。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 keep your options open 得出？

options.en: 尚未作出排除其他選擇的定案。
所有選項會自動一直等到自己想答覆時。
仍需要知道決定期限與對方安排。

contrast.explanationZh: 保留可能性不取消別人的期限或選擇。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說你想多比較，就不必告訴主辦者何時回覆；你想有禮貌地保留選項。哪句最好？

options.en: I would like to keep my options open, so I will ask the deadline and give a clear answer by then.
options.zh: 我想保留選項，所以會問期限，並在那之前清楚答覆。

options.en: I assumed silence would tell the organiser exactly how long I needed to decide.
options.zh: 我原以為，不作聲就能讓主辦者確切知道我需要考慮多久。

options.en: I would accept the place now and describe it as undecided only if a better offer arrives.
options.zh: 我會現在接受位置，等有較好的邀請才把它說成尚未定案。

dialogue.explanationZh: 透明未定案與期限才支持實際選項，不是先承諾後改稱沒決定。

speaking.en: I would like to keep my options open until Friday; please tell me if you need a firm answer before then.
speaking.zh: 我想保留選項到星期五；如果你需要我更早確定答覆，請告訴我。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說清保留選項的期限。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你跟表親計劃假期見面，但尚未收到學校補課日期。你想請她暫把兩個下午視為可能選項，說明周三會確認，也容許她若需早定便另作安排。用一至兩句英文提出暫定計劃，不把兩天都說成已答應。

examples.en: Could we keep our options open between Thursday afternoon and Saturday afternoon until I receive the catch-up class dates? I will confirm by Wednesday, and I understand if you need to make other plans sooner.
examples.zh: 在收到補課日期前，我們可否先保留星期四或星期六下午的選項？我會在周三前確認，也明白如果你需要更早另作安排。

examples.en: I would like to keep my options open for those two afternoons until Wednesday rather than promise both. Please tell me if that is too late for your plans, and we can choose another way to meet.
examples.zh: 我想保留那兩個下午的選項到周三，而不是兩天都答應。如果這對你的計劃太遲，請告訴我，我們可以另找見面方式。

writing.selfCheckZh: 清楚提出暫定而非兩邊已承諾的計劃，給確認時間並尊重對方期限；不把保留選項寫成別人必須一直等待。

takeaways.en: She kept her options open by asking about both interview dates before accepting either invitation.
takeaways.zh: 她在接受任何邀請前先問兩個面試日期，以保留選項。

takeaways.en: We are keeping our options open until the room measurements arrive, but have told the designer when we will choose a layout.
takeaways.zh: 我們保留選項到收到房間尺寸，但已告訴設計師何時會選定布局。

lessons.titleZh: 牽制行動或轉換的自由

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: A large mortgage could tie them down.

brief.meaningEn: Restrict someone’s freedom to move or change plans through a commitment or responsibility.
brief.meaningZh: 因承諾或責任而限制一個人移動或改變計劃的自由。
brief.grammar: tie someone down; tied/tying; a role, commitment or obligation can be the subject. Explain what restriction matters in that context.
brief.boundaryZh: 可指時間、地點或責任的牽制，不表示任何承諾都不好，也不表示已有承諾可自行不履行。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可指時間、地點或責任的牽制，不表示任何承諾都不好，也不表示已有承諾可自行不履行。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「牽制行動或轉換的自由」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: A year-long duty at the same workshop would tie me down when I am still waiting to hear where the field placement will be; I want to discuss a shorter role before agreeing.
listening.zh: 我還在等實地安排在哪裏的消息，若在同一工作坊接下一整年職責，會牽制我的去向；答應前，我想先談較短角色。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 長期固定地點的責任可能限制下一步移動，因此要先討論承諾範圍。
說話者已接下一年職責，現在宣布不通知就離開。
工作坊已確認可隨時遠端完成，所以沒有地點限制。
說話者認為每種短期責任都必定比長期更差。

listening.explanationZh: would/waiting/before agreeing 是尚未承諾前比較限制，不是任意違反已答應的工作。

reply.promptEn: Why are you asking about a shorter role?
reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼詢問較短的角色？

options.en: A year at one workshop could tie me down before I know where the field placement will be.
options.zh: 未知道實地安排在哪裏前，在同一工作坊待一年可能牽制我的去向。

options.en: The location of my next placement is uncertain, so a fixed year could create a conflict.
options.zh: 下一次安排的地點未定，所以固定一年可能造成衝突。

options.en: I want the commitment to fit what I can realistically promise.
options.zh: 我想承諾符合自己實際能答應的範圍。

options.en: A shorter role might let me contribute without promising to remain at one site for the whole year.
options.zh: 較短角色或能讓我參與，而不承諾全年留在同一地點。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 小組提供可在不同城市遠端完成、日期也可協議的短任務；人物目前沒有說明它限制了哪項計劃。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: We need to know what freedom the task would restrict before saying it would tie her down.
options.zh: 說任務會牽制她之前，需要知道它會限制哪種自由。

options.en: Having any responsibility establishes that she must remain in the same city for a year.
options.zh: 只要有責任，就足以確立她必須在同一城市留一年。

options.en: A flexible task means she will have no agreed work to complete.
options.zh: 任務有彈性，表示她沒有任何議定工作需要完成。

scene.explanationZh: 要具體說出牽制，不能由責任本身推固定地點，也不能由彈性推無責任。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 a commitment could tie me down 得出？

options.en: 某承諾可能限制我的下一步選擇。
任何已答應的工作都可不通知便自行離開。
可在答應前商量責任範圍或時間。

contrast.explanationZh: 描述限制不是解除責任的許可。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說如果角色會牽制你，最省事是先答應再到時離開；你想誠實商量。哪句最好？

options.en: If it would tie me down beyond what I can promise, I should discuss a shorter commitment before accepting.
options.zh: 如果它會牽制我，超過我能承諾的範圍，我應在接受前商量較短承諾。

options.en: I thought saying yes now would leave the group’s expectations unchanged if I left early later.
options.zh: 我原以為，現在說答應，之後提早離開也不會改變小組的期待。

options.en: I would compare the title of the role rather than the dates and location it requires.
options.zh: 我會比較角色職銜，而不是它要求的日期及地點。

dialogue.explanationZh: 誠實談限制比先作無法履行的承諾更能讓雙方安排；看實際責任，不只看名稱。

speaking.en: The fixed weekly visits could tie us down during the research trip, so we need to agree how the responsibility would be shared.
speaking.zh: 研究旅程期間，固定每周到訪可能牽制我們，所以需要議定責任怎樣分擔。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再交代具體限制與需要商量的責任。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友認為你喜歡她的狗，就應領養另一隻。你將有一段長時間在外地學習，知道飼養的持續照顧責任會限制行程；你想婉拒領養，仍可在本地時協助她散步。用一至兩句英文交代自己能可靠提供甚麼，而不是把喜歡動物當成已能承擔全部照顧。

examples.en: I love spending time with your dog, but taking on one of my own would tie me down to daily care I cannot reliably provide during the study trip. I can still help with walks while I am here, without making an adoption promise.
examples.zh: 我喜歡跟你的狗相處，但自己養一隻，會讓我受每日照顧責任牽制；外地學習期間，我無法可靠提供照顧。我在這裏時仍可幫忙散步，但不作領養承諾。

examples.en: Adopting a dog now could tie me down in a way that conflicts with the long trip I have planned. I would rather offer help with your dog while I am in town than promise care I cannot sustain.
examples.zh: 現在領養狗，可能帶來與已計劃長途行程衝突的牽制。我寧願在本地時幫忙照顧你的狗，不承諾自己無法持續的照顧。

writing.selfCheckZh: 把持續責任與具體行程相連，誠實拒絕不能維持的承諾，也提出有限可行的幫助；不把喜歡當成能力或把牽制當自行失責的許可。

takeaways.en: The daily collection duty would tie him down to one location during a period when his work often took him elsewhere.
takeaways.zh: 他的工作常要到別處時，每日收取物品的職責會把他牽制在同一地點。

takeaways.en: She asked whether the partnership would tie her down to fixed weekends before agreeing to help with the travelling exhibition.
takeaways.zh: 答應協助巡迴展覽前，她問合作會否把自己限制在固定周末。

lessons.titleZh: 同時兼顧互相競爭的需要

target.pattern: \b(?:juggle|juggles|juggled|juggling) (?:three things at once|work and family duties)\b

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Buyers must juggle three things at once.

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 8, row 5; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Juggling work and family duties left him exhausted.

brief.meaningEn: Manage two or more competing tasks, demands or priorities at the same time; the original three-item frame is one example rather than a fixed numerical requirement.
brief.meaningZh: 同時兼顧兩項或以上互相爭取時間、資源或注意力的事情；原來三項的句型只是例子，不是固定數目要求。
brief.grammar: juggle competing demands; this lesson recognises juggle three things at once and juggle/juggling work and family duties. The demands overlap in time or attention; naming them does not prove success.
brief.boundaryZh: 要交代需兼顧的三件事及張力，不表示已兼顧得完美，也不只是按順序完成三項互不相干的任務。
brief.misconceptionZh: 要交代需兼顧的三件事及張力，不表示已兼顧得完美，也不只是按順序完成三項互不相干的任務。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「同時兼顧互相競爭的需要」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: For the exhibition opening, I had to juggle three things at once: answering the guests, checking the captions and helping the volunteers find their stations; each needed attention during the same hour.
listening.zh: 展覽開幕時，我要同時兼顧三件事：回應來賓、檢查說明牌，以及幫義工找到崗位；三者都在同一小時需要注意。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 同一時段有三項需要分配注意力的工作。
三項工作分別在三個月完成，從不重疊。
三項工作已由別人完全接手，說話者沒有兼顧。
說話者已證明每項工作都完成得毫無錯漏。

listening.explanationZh: same hour/each attention 表示同時兼顧，不保證完美，也不是完全分開做。

reply.promptEn: Why was the opening hour demanding?
reply.promptZh: 開幕那一小時為甚麼很吃力？

options.en: I had to juggle three things at once, with guests, captions and volunteers all needing attention.
options.zh: 我得同時兼顧三件事，來賓、說明牌和義工都需要注意。

options.en: Several kinds of work competed for my attention during the same hour.
options.zh: 同一小時內，幾類工作都在爭取我的注意。

options.en: I needed to move between welcoming people, checking text and guiding the helpers.
options.zh: 我需要在迎接來賓、檢查文字和指導幫手之間轉換。

options.en: The tasks overlapped rather than waiting neatly for one another to finish.
options.zh: 工作互相重疊，不是整齊等上一項做完才開始。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 人物要兼顧照顧弟弟的放學安排、晚間課程和小組交稿；三者這周的時間有重疊，她正在協商分工，尚未全部解決。哪句最準確？

options.en: She needs to juggle three things at once and is still working out how to share the demands.
options.zh: 她需要同時兼顧三件事，仍在想辦法分擔各項需要。

options.en: The responsibilities can be handled one after another this week without any overlap to negotiate.
options.zh: 這周的責任可一項接一項處理，沒有需要協商的重疊。

options.en: Naming three demands establishes that she has already balanced them successfully.
options.zh: 說出三項需要，足以確立她已成功兼顧。

scene.explanationZh: 題目給時間重疊與正在協商分工，不能改成互不重疊；辨認三項也不等於已成功兼顧。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 juggle three things at once 得出？

options.en: 同時有多項需要爭取注意或資源。
每項需要都已獲完美處理，不會有取捨。
可以再交代優先次序、分工或需要的協助。

contrast.explanationZh: 兼顧描述管理壓力，不保證結果完美。

dialogue.promptZh: 展覽開幕時，你要同時回應來賓、檢查說明牌和指導義工；朋友說能列出三項任務，就已證明完全應付得來。你想說明仍要找分工。哪句最好？

options.en: I need to juggle three things at once, but naming them does not settle which tasks someone else can take.
options.zh: 我要同時兼顧三件事，但說出它們，並沒有解決哪些工作可由別人接手的問題。

options.en: I read the list as a sequence: finish all the guest questions, then check the captions, and only after that guide the volunteers.
options.zh: 我把清單讀成先後次序：先答完來賓所有問題，再檢查說明牌，之後才指導義工。

options.en: I would judge the workload only by the number of tasks, not when each needs attention.
options.zh: 我只會按任務數量判斷工作量，不看各項何時需要注意。

dialogue.explanationZh: 實際需要在同一時段出現，不能只把清單順序當可行時間表；還要議定支援與分工。

speaking.en: I need to juggle three things at once this week, so could we agree which part of the preparation you can take over?
speaking.zh: 這周我要同時兼顧三件事，所以我們可否議定準備工作哪部分可由你接手？
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再把同時兼顧與具體求助連起來。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你在為校刊畫一幅插圖，要同時顧及史料準確、低年級讀者看得懂，以及指定版面大小。你想請編輯先說清哪個細節必須保留，讓你能調整畫法，不聲稱三者必然可全部滿足。用一至兩句英文向編輯提問。

examples.en: I need to juggle three things at once in this illustration: historical accuracy, clarity for younger readers and the available page space. Which details must stay so I can adjust the drawing around them?
examples.zh: 這幅插圖要同時兼顧三件事：史料準確、低年級讀者能理解，以及可用版面。哪些細節必須保留，讓我按此調整畫法？

examples.en: To juggle three things at once, I need a clearer priority between accurate detail, an accessible image and the fixed space. Could you mark the details that cannot be left out before I redraw it?
examples.zh: 要同時兼顧三件事，我需要更清楚知道準確細節、易懂圖像和固定空間之間的優先次序。我重畫前，你可否標出不能省略的細節？

writing.selfCheckZh: 說清三項並存需要及其張力，向編輯提出能幫助調整的問題；不把列出需求當成已解決，也不保證完全沒有取捨。

takeaways.en: The coordinator had to juggle three things at once when the speakers arrived, the slides stopped working and the welcome desk needed instructions.
takeaways.zh: 講者到達、投影片出問題、接待桌又需要指示時，統籌要同時兼顧三件事。

takeaways.en: During the gallery move, Priya was juggling work and family duties, so she asked for help with packing.
takeaways.zh: 畫廊搬遷期間，普莉雅要同時兼顧工作和家庭責任，因此請人幫忙執拾。

lessons.titleZh: 多項要求不能全保留，需要取捨

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: When budgets are tight, something has to give.

brief.meaningEn: At least one demand or constraint must change because all cannot continue together as they stand.
brief.meaningZh: 各項要求以目前形式無法同時維持，至少一項需要調整或讓步。
brief.grammar: something has to give when time/money/demands cannot all fit; name the competing constraints and discuss what to change, rather than imply a particular person must lose.
brief.boundaryZh: 表示需要取捨，不單獨決定應犧牲甚麼或誰；也不是說所有目標都要放棄。
brief.misconceptionZh: 表示需要取捨，不單獨決定應犧牲甚麼或誰；也不是說所有目標都要放棄。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「多項要求不能全保留，需要取捨」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: We have one afternoon for three long interviews and checking the recording, so something has to give; we need to shorten the interviews or add another session rather than promise it will all fit.
listening.zh: 我們要在一個下午完成三場長訪問和錄音檢查，所以必須有所取捨；我們需要縮短訪問或多安排一節，而不是承諾全部都放得下。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 目前要求不能全放進時間內，需要商量調整哪部分。
說話者已決定取消整個計劃，沒有其他可能。
三場訪問都已完成，現在只是在整理名單。
這句話已指定一定由受訪者犧牲自己的所有時間。

listening.explanationZh: one afternoon 與多項時間需求造成張力，shorten/or another session 保留選擇。

reply.promptEn: Why can’t we simply promise the whole plan for one afternoon?
reply.promptZh: 為甚麼不能直接承諾一個下午完成整個計劃？

options.en: Something has to give because the long interviews and checking time do not all fit.
options.zh: 必須有所取捨，因為長訪問與檢查時間不能全放進去。

options.en: We need to change the length or the number of sessions rather than ignore the time limit.
options.zh: 我們需要調整長度或節數，而不是忽略時間限制。

options.en: The current demands exceed the time we have agreed to use.
options.zh: 目前要求超過已議定可用的時間。

options.en: A promise without an adjustment would leave someone expecting work we cannot fit in.
options.zh: 若沒有調整就承諾，會令別人期待我們無法塞進時間內的工作。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 演出最初比時限長二十分鐘，但小組已試好縮短版，現在包括換場仍比時限少兩分鐘。評論沿用舊時間表，說必須再刪節。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: The earlier clash has been adjusted; saying something has to give again needs evidence of a remaining conflict in the current programme.
options.zh: 原來衝突已經調整；要再說必須有所取捨，需要證明目前節目仍有未解決衝突。

options.en: The original twenty-minute excess is still the current figure even after the tested shorter version.
options.zh: 即使已試過縮短版，原來超時二十分鐘仍是目前的數字。

options.en: Meeting the time limit establishes that the cast has already agreed which artistic changes it prefers.
options.zh: 符合時限，足以確立演員已議定偏好哪些藝術改動。

scene.explanationZh: 按目前已測試時間判斷，不能沿用舊超時數字；解決時間限制也不等於所有藝術選擇已獲偏好。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 something has to give 得出？

options.en: 目前一些要求不能全部照舊並存。
已能確定應犧牲哪一個人的需要，毋須討論。
可比較不同調整方式及其影響。

contrast.explanationZh: 需要讓步與決定誰或哪項讓步，是兩個不同層次。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友聽到要取捨，就說一定先刪掉新成員的部分；你想先公平比較方案。哪句最好？

options.en: Something has to give, but that does not tell us whose part to cut; let’s compare shorter versions and the time each would save.
options.zh: 必須有所取捨，但這沒有告訴我們該刪誰的部分；讓我們比較縮短版本及各自能省的時間。

options.en: I thought saying there was a time conflict already identified the new member’s part as the problem.
options.zh: 我原以為，只要說時間有衝突，就已指出新成員的部分是問題。

options.en: I thought keeping the familiar programme unchanged should be the starting point, so I had not considered shortening those parts.
options.zh: 我原以為應先保持熟悉節目不變，所以沒有考慮縮短那些部分。

dialogue.explanationZh: 由限制出發比較調整，不把成員身分當成答案。

speaking.en: Something has to give if we want both careful checking and an earlier finish, so we should agree which task can move to tomorrow.
speaking.zh: 如果既想仔細檢查又想更早完成，就必須有所取捨，所以我們應議定哪項工作可移到明天。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說清限制與需要協議的取捨。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你們設計一個展覽字卡，想保留完整長篇引文、加上清楚的雙語說明，也要用同一張小字卡而不縮小字體。你要向設計伙伴說明這些要求目前不相容，請一起比較較短引文或分開兩張的方案。用一至兩句英文提出討論。

examples.en: Something has to give if we keep the full quotation, clear bilingual notes and the same small card without reducing the type. Could we compare a shorter quotation with using two cards?
examples.zh: 如果要保留完整引文、清楚雙語說明及同一張小字卡，又不縮小字體，就必須有所取捨。我們可否比較較短引文與用兩張字卡的方案？

examples.en: With all this text and a fixed type size, something has to give. Let’s test a shorter extract and a two-card version before deciding which requirement to change.
examples.zh: 文字這麼多，字體大小又固定，就必須有所取捨。讓我們先試較短節錄及兩張字卡的版本，再決定改哪項要求。

writing.selfCheckZh: 交代互相牽制的要求，提出可比較的修改而非直接指定誰讓步；不把承認限制寫成整個展覽不可能進行。

takeaways.en: With a fixed rehearsal end time and two extra scenes, something has to give, so the cast is comparing possible cuts before the next meeting.
takeaways.zh: 排練完結時間固定，又加了兩場戲，就必須有所取捨，所以演員正於下次聚會前比較可作的刪改。

takeaways.en: The editor said something has to give when the full interview and large photographs would not fit on the agreed pages.
takeaways.zh: 完整訪問及大幅照片放不進議定頁數時，編輯說必須有所取捨。

lessons.titleZh: 貴得令人咋舌

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: The central flat had eye-watering rent.

brief.meaningEn: Extremely or surprisingly expensive in the price context being described.
brief.meaningZh: 在價錢語境中，指貴得驚人、令人咋舌。
brief.grammar: an eye-watering price/rent/fee; eye-watering is hyphenated before the noun. Here the tears image intensifies a reaction to cost rather than reporting actual crying.
brief.boundaryZh: 強烈評價價格高，不提供精確金額，也不自動證明收費不合法或任何人都付不起；要留意比較基準與說話語氣。
brief.misconceptionZh: 強烈評價價格高，不提供精確金額，也不自動證明收費不合法或任何人都付不起；要留意比較基準與說話語氣。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「貴得令人咋舌」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: The fee for the larger exhibition stand was eye-watering compared with our small group’s event budget, so we asked what a simpler display would cost before choosing.
listening.zh: 大型展位的費用相對我們小組的活動預算，貴得令人咋舌，所以我們選擇前先問較簡單展示的費用。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 說話者強烈覺得大型展位相對預算很貴，仍在查詢另一方案。
說話者已確定收費違法，正在報告調查結果。
小組已選定大型展位，查較簡單方案只是為其他活動留備案。
較簡單方案報價已低於預算，小組已確認選用。

listening.explanationZh: compared budget 給大型展位的評價，asked before choosing 表明還未選定；沒有說較簡單方案報價已收到或已獲選。

reply.promptEn: Why did the group ask about a simpler display?
reply.promptZh: 小組為甚麼詢問較簡單的展示？

options.en: The larger stand came with an eye-watering fee relative to their event budget.
options.zh: 相對活動預算，大型展位的費用高得令人咋舌。

options.en: The price of the bigger option was far higher than they had planned for.
options.zh: 較大方案的價格遠高於他們原來的預算。

options.en: They wanted to compare a less elaborate option before committing that much money.
options.zh: 承諾花那麼多錢前，他們想比較較簡單方案。

options.en: Their budget made the larger display difficult to justify without checking alternatives.
options.zh: 按他們的預算，未查其他方案前，很難支持選大型展示。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 評論者寫某場演出票價 eye-watering，但沒有列金額或說自己的收入。編輯想準確概括這個字所表達的內容。哪句最好？

options.en: The writer presents the price as shockingly high, but the word alone does not give the amount or prove that everyone is unable to pay.
options.zh: 作者把價錢形容為高得驚人，但單憑這個字，沒有金額，也不能證明每個人都付不起。

options.en: The adjective establishes that nobody in the audience can afford the ticket.
options.zh: 這個形容詞足以確立觀眾中沒有人付得起票價。

options.en: Using a strong price adjective means the writer has already checked how the fee was calculated.
options.zh: 用強烈價錢形容詞，表示作者已核對費用的計算方式。

scene.explanationZh: 強烈評價不包含所有人的支付能力或成本查核。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種資訊不能單憑 eye-watering 的價錢用法知道？

options.en: 說話者認為費用高得驚人。
確切金額及每位讀者能否負擔。
這個字比單說 expensive 語氣更強烈。

contrast.explanationZh: 強烈程度不等於數字，也不能代替每個人的具體情況。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說評論用了 eye-watering，就一定證明店家不誠實；你想保留評價與證據的分別。哪句最好？

options.en: Eye-watering tells us the writer found the price extremely high; we would need other evidence before making a claim about dishonesty.
options.zh: Eye-watering 告訴我們作者覺得價格極高；要指稱不誠實，仍需其他證據。

options.en: I thought a strong reaction to the price was itself an account of how the seller set it.
options.zh: 我原以為，對價錢的強烈反應，本身就在交代賣方怎樣定價。

options.en: I would read it as a precise comparison with every other supplier’s quote.
options.zh: 我會把它讀成跟所有其他供應商報價的精確比較。

dialogue.explanationZh: 價格評價不確立定價過程，也不是完整報價調查。

speaking.en: The full installation has an eye-watering price for our small project, so could we see a quote for a simpler version?
speaking.zh: 對我們的小項目而言，完整裝置價格高得令人咋舌，所以可否讓我們看較簡單版本的報價？
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再把強烈價格評價與具體查詢連起來。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：校刊草稿根據未確認傳聞，把學校旅行費寫成「貴得令人咋舌」。你尚未看到實際金額及包含項目，想請同學先查明再決定語氣，避免把傳聞寫成已查證評價。用一至兩句英文提出出版前的要求。

examples.en: Before describing the trip fee as eye-watering, could we check the actual amount and what it includes? I do not want the newsletter to present a rumour as a checked comparison.
examples.zh: 把旅行費形容為貴得令人咋舌前，我們可否先查實金額及包含甚麼？我不想校刊把傳聞當成已核實的比較。

examples.en: I am not ready to call the fee eye-watering on the basis of that message alone. Let’s confirm the figure and the included activities before deciding how strongly to describe it in print.
examples.zh: 我未準備好只憑那則訊息，就說費用貴得令人咋舌。讓我們先確認金額及包含的活動，再決定刊印時用多強烈的形容。

writing.selfCheckZh: 提出出版前需查證的具體資訊，讓強烈語氣有清楚依據；不因傳聞先下定論，也不把未確認寫成已知便宜或昂貴。

takeaways.en: The custom case had an eye-watering price beside the standard one, so the curator asked which features accounted for the difference.
takeaways.zh: 訂製盒相對標準盒的價格高得令人咋舌，所以策展人問哪些特色造成差額。

takeaways.en: She described the festival’s late booking fee as eye-watering, then gave the actual figure so readers could judge it for themselves.
takeaways.zh: 她把藝術節的遲訂費形容為高得令人咋舌，然後列出實際金額，讓讀者自行判斷。

lessons.titleZh: 調整餘地

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Low-income families have the least room to manoeuvre.

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 41, row 4; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A larger budget gives the team room to manoeuvre.

brief.meaningEn: Freedom to change a plan or respond to new circumstances; the least room marks the smallest amount within a comparison.
brief.meaningZh: 調整計劃或應變的餘地；the least room 表示在比較中餘地最少。
brief.grammar: Have or give someone room to manoeuvre; have the least room to manoeuvre when comparing options. Room means flexibility, not physical floor space.
brief.register: Neutral planning metaphor; a team may use it in a budget or schedule discussion, with the superlative only when a comparison is stated.
brief.boundaryZh: 需說清在哪方面、跟誰比較；餘地最少不等於完全沒有任何行動，也不等於不願配合。
brief.misconceptionZh: 需說清在哪方面、跟誰比較；餘地最少不等於完全沒有任何行動，也不等於不願配合。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「在比較之中，可調整的餘地最少」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: Of the three teams, the evening crew had the least room to manoeuvre because its transport ended at ten, while the others could change their finishing times more easily.
listening.zh: 三隊之中，晚班隊的調整餘地最少，因為他們的交通服務十時結束，另外兩隊則較容易更改完結時間。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 在這三隊的完結時間比較中，晚班隊受交通限制最大。
晚班隊只是最不願合作，沒有實際時間限制。
三隊的交通與時間完全相同，沒有比較基礎。
晚班隊已取消所有工作，沒有需要協議的安排。

listening.explanationZh: of three/transport ended/others could change 給比較範圍及原因，不是態度判定或完全不能行動。

reply.promptEn: Why did the evening crew need particular attention in the schedule?
reply.promptZh: 為甚麼編時間表時需要特別顧及晚班隊？

options.en: It had the least room to manoeuvre because its transport ended at ten.
options.zh: 因為交通十時結束，他們的調整餘地最少。

options.en: The other teams could move their finishing times more easily.
options.zh: 其他隊較容易移動完結時間。

options.en: A later finish would create a transport problem that the others did not face in the same way.
options.zh: 較遲完結會造成其他隊沒有同樣面對的交通問題。

options.en: Their constraint was less flexible, so a common timetable could affect them differently.
options.zh: 他們的限制較難調整，所以相同時間表可能對他們有不同影響。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 三位合作伙伴都想改會議時間；兩人可自由調班，一人要先安排接孩子，能選的時段較少。哪句最準確？

options.en: Among these partners, the person arranging childcare has the least room to manoeuvre over meeting times.
options.zh: 這些伙伴之中，需要安排接孩子的人，在會議時間上調整餘地最少。

options.en: Fewer available times establish that this person values the project less than the others.
options.zh: 可選時段較少，足以確立這人比其他人更不重視項目。

options.en: Having a constraint means this person cannot be asked about any possible alternative.
options.zh: 有一項限制，表示不能再問這人有沒有其他可行選項。

scene.explanationZh: 指出實際可選時間，不把限制誤作意願，也不預先取消商量。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 has the least room to manoeuvre 得出？

options.en: 在明確比較範圍內，調整自由較其他人少。
這人必然最不合作，所以不用了解原因。
仍需知道限制屬於時間、資源還是其他方面。

contrast.explanationZh: 較少餘地是處境，不是人格或配合意願的證明。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說大家同一票決定時間已夠公平，不必問受交通限制最多的一隊；你想了解影響再議定。哪句最好？

options.en: The crew with the least room to manoeuvre may face a different cost from the same finishing time; let’s ask what alternatives are actually possible.
options.zh: 調整餘地最少的隊伍，可能因同一完結時間承受不同代價；讓我們問清實際有哪些替代。

options.en: I thought equal numbers of votes meant everyone had an equal ability to change their transport.
options.zh: 我原以為，票數一樣，就表示每個人改交通安排的能力也一樣。

options.en: I would take a limited choice of times as evidence that the crew prefers not to join.
options.zh: 我會把時段選擇有限，當成那隊較不想參加的證據。

dialogue.explanationZh: 相同程序不抹去不同限制；問具體可能比以意願解讀更準確。

speaking.en: The volunteers with the least room to manoeuvre over travel times should be asked about workable alternatives before we fix the end of the event.
speaking.zh: 在交通時間上調整餘地最少的義工，應在我們定下活動完結時間前，獲詢問有哪些可行替代。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說清比較範圍與限制方面。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：三個展覽小組要交模型，一組用借來的模型，必須保留原狀；另兩組用自製模型，可以重新上色。統一評分草稿卻要求全部重新上色。你想向籌委指出借件小組在改動物件上餘地最少，建議可用可拆標籤展示解說，而非把不能上色當成缺投入。用一至兩句英文提出規則修改。

examples.en: Of the three groups, the one using the borrowed model has the least room to manoeuvre over changes, because it must return the object unaltered. Could the criteria allow removable labels instead of treating repainting as the only sign of effort?
examples.zh: 三組之中，使用借來模型的一組，在改動方面調整餘地最少，因為必須原狀歸還。評分可否容許可拆標籤，而不是把重新上色當成唯一投入證明？

examples.en: Among the three groups, the borrowers have the least room to manoeuvre in redesigning their model. I suggest accepting a removable explanation panel as another way to present their work, without penalising them for respecting the loan condition.
examples.zh: 三組之中，借件小組在重新設計模型上，調整餘地最少。我建議接受可拆解說板作另一種展示工作的方法，不因他們遵守借用條件而扣分。

writing.selfCheckZh: 比較三組在改動物件上的實際限制，提出可接受的替代展示準則；不把限制當態度差，也不假定遵守條件就完全沒有創作空間。

takeaways.en: Of the applicants, those relying on a single daily bus had the least room to manoeuvre when the interview time changed.
takeaways.zh: 申請者之中，依靠每日唯一一班巴士的人，在面試時間改動時調整餘地最少。

takeaways.en: An extra guide on call gives the museum team room to manoeuvre if a scheduled guide falls ill.
takeaways.zh: 多一位隨時候命的導賞員，讓博物館團隊在原定導賞員生病時有調整餘地。
